references.text: Horeb is another name for Mount Sinai, where Moses met God at the burning bush.
Kadesh-Barnea is mentioned as the place where the spies returned after exploring the land of Canaan.
Mount Seir was Edom's territory, which Israel had to pass through on their way to the promised land.
Kadesh is mentioned as one of the camping sites during Israel's journey through the wilderness.
Mount Seir is identified as the home of Esau and the Edomites.
The Lord instructs Israel not to attack the Edomites in the region of Seir, since it was given to Esau's descendants.
Horeb is mentioned as the place where Moses struck the rock to give the people water.
